# Vendored libusb

This directory contains libusb 1.0.30 source from upstream tag v1.0.30.

Upstream: https://github.com/libusb/libusb
License: LGPL-2.1-or-later (see COPYING)

The Xcode target compiles the macOS/Darwin libusb sources directly into the
application, so Homebrew, MacPorts, pkg-config, CMake and Ninja are not needed.
